activities.title: Community Awareness Through Nukkad Nataks
activities.text:
• 2025 – Government Schemes Awareness: Organized a street play in a slum community to educate residents about various government welfare schemes, their benefits, and eligibility. 
• 2026 – Blood Donation Awareness: Conducted a street play at a hospital to spread awareness about the importance of voluntary blood donation and its life-saving impact.

activities.title: Event Management & Coordination
activities.text:
• AI Summit (2025) – Contributed to organizing a technical summit focused on Artificial Intelligence.
• Orientation (2025) – Coordinated activities and event execution for incoming students.
• Internal Hackathon (2025) – Organized and coordinated the university-level technical hackathon.
• Sports Day (2025 & 2026) – Organized and coordinated university sports events and activities. 
• Nukkad Natak (2025 & 2026) – Organized street-play initiatives promoting social awareness and community engagement.
